title: On the second smallest ideal right-angled hyperbolic four-polytope
abstract: The regular ideal right-angled 24-cell has volume $4\pi^2/3$ and uniquely minimizes volume among entirely ideal right-angled hyperbolic four-polytopes. We prove that the second distinct volume is $8\pi^2/3$, attained uniquely by the reflection double of the 24-cell across an octahedral facet. We also show that an entirely ideal right-angled four-polytope whose facets are regular ideal octahedra or their doubles across triangular faces decomposes into a chain of regular 24-cells, with opposite cutting facets in each intermediate cell.
